outputColorSpaceNotes: ColorSpace Automatic preserves grayscale/YCbCr defaults. Explicit Grayscale converts RGB luminance or consumes only Y from direct YCbCr; YCbCr output accepts grayscale with neutral 128 chroma, deliberately differing from the pinned GrayscaleToYCbCr zero-fill helper. RGB preserves normalized R/G/B layouts or replicates grayscale, rejects direct YCbCr input, emits R/G/B IDs without JFIF/Adobe, and uses shared Annex K luma quantizer 0 and Huffman 0. RGB defaults to 1x1 regardless preset; custom Luma/Cb/Cr factors map to R/G/B. AQ analyzes green, disables for subsampled green and uses uniform 0.5 AC multipliers/offsets; disabled RGB bias is 0. Transfer hints and UseStandardQuantizationTables do not change RGB output. This extends normalized BGR/alpha layouts beyond upstream RGB transform support, adds no profile generation or color management, and does not implement XYB.
iccTransferLookupNotes: Opt-in InferCicpTransferFunctionFromIccProfile applies only when CicpTransferFunction is 2; every explicit non-2 code overrides lookup. Ported from FindCICPTag and LookupCICPTransferFunctionFromICCProfile in lib/extras/enc/jpegli.cc: complete directory, last cicp entry, declared size >=12, readable first12 payload bytes with cicp type, transfer at byte9. Invalid or absent lookup falls back2 and ICC embedding remains unchanged. Header fields, other CICP fields, reserved bytes and declared extent beyond12 are not validated, matching the raw helper. Unlike upstream's uint32 count arithmetic, bounds use division before indexing to prevent overflow. Constant working storage and periodic cancellation, no profile transform or generation.
transferFunctionNotes: CicpTransferFunction defaults to 2 (unspecified) and accepts 0..255, rejecting aliases that upstream's int setter would narrow to uint8_t. Codes 16 (PQ) and 18 (HLG) multiply perceptual global scale by 0.4 and 0.5 before 4:2:0 compensation. Other codes preserve default tuning. QuantValsToDistance uses the same transfer scale without 4:2:0 compensation, including standard shared-chroma selectors; standard table generation itself ignores the hint. No sample conversion, color management, CICP marker or automatic profile is provided, and eight-bit output does not establish HDR conformance.
standardQuantizationNotes: Opt-in UseStandardQuantizationTables uses the pinned quant.cc Annex K luma and shared chroma matrices, scaled by 0.01 * DistanceToLinearQuality(resolved distance), rounded and clamped to 1..255 without 4:2:0 compensation. Clamping precedes integer conversion, including immediately below distance 25 where upstream's conversion overflows; native parity is not claimed for that edge. Color emits table IDs 0/1 and frame selectors 0/1/1; grayscale emits only 0. Adaptive inference uses upstream quant_tbl_no indexing, including the perceptual Cb base for both chroma components, while zero-bias multipliers remain component-specific. This is not libjpeg byte or quality parity; the default retains perceptual tables and existing bytes.
distanceNotes: Optional positive finite Distance overrides Quality while keeping Quality validation. Null uses the public fractional QualityToDistance polynomial and preserves existing bytes. The resolved distance controls table generation in all input and scan paths; adaptive multipliers remain table-derived. Tables clamp to baseline 1..255 even at finite float extremes; upstream C++ overflow behavior at such extremes is not a parity claim. Distance is not a measured or guaranteed perceptual error, and encoding remains lossy.
iptcNotes: Raw opaque IPTC-IIM data is embedded in one Photoshop APP13 resource 0x0404 with an empty Pascal name, unsigned big-endian unpadded data length and even-byte padding. The single-marker input limit is 65,506 bytes. No IIM validation, text conversion, digest resource or XMP/Exif reconciliation is performed.
automaticXmpNotes: Opt-in oversized standard packets move their full XML root into extended XMP with a generated digest-only standard packet by default. StandardXmpProperties can retain complete selected top-level attributes and elements in a compact standard envelope, preserving inherited namespaces and XML attributes, with pre-output validation of its final UTF-8 size including the digest link. Parsing requires ordinary empty-subject XMP envelopes and uses packet-sized storage. Smaller and manually partitioned packets retain their existing bytes.
samplingNotes: Integer sample areas use frame-wide component factor maxima, including subsampled luma with adaptive quantization disabled as upstream. Three-row areas include all three rows; the pinned ChooseDownsampleMethods instead selects two-row kernels for vertical factor 3.
floatInputNotes: Out-of-range float input is opt-in and retains samples without clipping. Unlike upstream coefficient storage, a bounded preflight requires finite scaling and computation, rounded DC -1024..1023 and AC -1023..1023 before output, independently of scan or Huffman settings.
